question: Does a fresh unchanged native V50 stationary hold accept all 240 counterfactual commands at each of the four exposed R10S recovery-complete boundaries, with exact session/stateless agreement?
timing: Declared before the first native call. This study selects no physical successor and consumes no new physical population.
input_transformation: Copy the exact readiness source packet and independently reproduce its projection. Build the existing hold frame from the retained native torso pose through the actual frame helper, start a fresh V50 session with all four gait steps at 6, rebase only session clock, task frame and adapter capability. Hold all physical observations fixed; do not integrate or advance any body. Copy the first retained no-kick hold command with zero amplitude and zero desired velocity. Carry only fresh hold memory between calls.
measured_outputs: native call and byte agreement counts
first, last and maximum joint target error relative to frozen measured pose
maximum change in target between commands
adequacy: The negative upright terminal exercises the proposed new entry domain. The other three terminals cover the existing successful upright, partial and prone boundaries as exposed component checks. Repeated frozen observations expose the complete bounded hold memory progression but provide no settling or contact-dynamics prediction.
not_covered: hold termination and fresh V56 start
full route retention and independent replay
interpretation: A pass permits considering an explicit bounded post-recovery hold successor. Any refusal is retained and diagnosed; it is not a new physical failure and does not change R10S outcomes. Target metrics are descriptive, not new behavioral thresholds.
